node.title: Re: excel to hash
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [dist://Spreadsheet-ExcelHashTable] has only one release on CPAN that is six years old, has [http://cpansearch.perl.org/src/SRINIPERL/Spreadsheet-ExcelHashTable-0.02/t/|practically no tests], and is [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Spreadsheet-ExcelHashTable|failing] those that it does have (POD tests). If I had to guess, perhaps the underlying module [mod://Spreadsheet::ParseExcel] has changed its API, or there is some other underlying problem. However, personally I would stay away from that module, you may want to look at [mod://Spreadsheet::Read] and the modules it depends on instead.
